inbox.makeRequestFor: Draft a booking request from {name}’s message
inbox.requestNothing: Nothing in that message reads as a booking.
inbox.requestDraftExists: Finish or clear your unfinished Log a call form under New booking before drafting another request.

callNote.label: Notes from the call
callNote.hint: Type it as it came. Fill reads it into the form, and the note keeps your words.
callNote.nothing: Nothing in the note fills a field.

import.mapHint: Sends the column names and a few masked values from the first 50 rows. A column that mentions health is never sent.
import.mapNothing: No other column could be matched. Rename a header and choose the file again.
import.pendingCards: Cards read from a suggested column come in for review, not verified.

waiver.label: Start from your current waiver
waiver.hint: Choose its PDF and the text lands in the box above. Check it line by line against the PDF before you publish: AI can misread a clause. The signature lines and medical questions are left out because the online form asks them itself. This is not legal advice.
waiver.failed: That file could not be read as a waiver. Choose a PDF of your release, under 5 MB.

setup.heading: Set up from your website
setup.intro: Paste your site and AI reads it for your tagline, phone, desk hours, prices and departures. Nothing changes until you accept a line.
setup.policyHint: Copy it to wherever your divers read policies.

notices.read: Read. Accept the lines that are right.
notices.nothing: Nothing on that site could be used. Check the address and try again.
notices.badSite: That address cannot be read. Paste your shop’s own website, starting with https://.
notices.dark: AI suggestions aren’t available for this shop right now.
